text: Global manufacturers to showcase latest homeware designs at IGHE 2026

HÀ NỘI - More than 200 companies will showcase homeware, kitchenware and gift products at the 2026 Global Housewares Expo (IGHE 2026) in HCM City this December, as the event seeks to connect international manufacturers with buyers and distribution networks in Việt Nam and neighbouring markets.

The business-to-business (B2B) exhibition will run from December 10 to 13 at Hall A of the Saigon Exhibition and Convention Centre (SECC), covering 10,000 square metres and featuring approximately 350 booths.

Organised by CHAOYU EXPO, CHWANG and VINEXAD, in coordination with CHAOYU EXPO Vietnam, the event aims to provide a direct trading platform for manufacturers, brands, importers and distributors in the homeware industry.
The exhibition comes amid growing demand for household products as Việt Nam's consumer market expands and shopping channels increasingly integrate online and offline retail.
The country had a population of approximately 102.3 million in 2025, while the Government has set a GDP growth target of more than 10 per cent for 2026, according to the organisers.

The 2025 edition attracted more than 22,000 professional visits from 15 countries and territories, with over 200 companies operating more than 300 booths and displaying upwards of 10,000 product designs.
Building on that participation, the 2026 event will focus on manufacturers from major Chinese production centres, including Guangdong and Zhejiang provinces.
Exhibitors are expected to include companies specialising in drinkware, plastic household products, ceramics, kitchenware and metal products.

Among the featured products, X&W Creative Brand Ltd is expected to introduce vacuum flasks featuring Disney and Chiikawa designs, while Chaozhou Mingchen Ceramics Co Ltd will present tableware featuring Hello Kitty and Crayon Shin-chan designs.
Other exhibitors will showcase stainless steel kitchenware, food storage containers and lunch boxes.
IGHE 2026 will cover five main product categories: kitchenware, dining and drinkware; home and decoration; cleaning and storage; travel and outdoors; and gifts and promotional items.
Products will range from cookware, cups and ceramic goods to household textiles, cleaning tools, luggage and corporate gifts.
The organisers expect more than 15,000 professional visits, primarily from retail chains, supermarkets, e-commerce platforms, importers, wholesalers and regional distributors.
A B2B Matching Programme will connect exhibitors with buyers based on their sourcing requirements, while a VIP Buyer Programme will provide dedicated support to key buyers.

The participation of e-commerce platforms including Amazon, Shopee and TikTok Shop Vietnam is also expected to provide opportunities to discuss online retail trends and strategies for reaching consumers.
The exhibition will take place daily from 9am to 5pm. - BIZHUB/VNS
